Overview

Abha is a city in Asir with a population of 385,000. The capital of the Asir Region in southwestern Saudi Arabia, known for its mild climate and mountain scenery. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
